title: Fourth power of the discrete derivative
statement: Let $f$ be a function from the $n$-dimensional sign cube to $\{\pm1\}$, let $i$ be a coordinate, and let $x$ be a point of the cube. The fourth power of the discrete derivative of the real-valued version of $f$ in coordinate $i$ at $x$ equals its square.
hypotheses_covered: A Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
